class_id: an admin write path that performs only part of the admin write contract
feature: every admin route that changes a published value (web/app/api/admin/**: update-field, update-field-record, dynamic/[table]/[id], conflicts/resolve and bulk-resolve, corrigendum accept)
symptom: an admin save must do four things together: write the value to the table the page reads, record it as an ADMIN value the scraper will not overwrite (protection row), record who and why (audit), and drop the cache key the page is served from. A path that does fewer reports success while the page shows the old value, or shows the new value until the next scraper cycle silently replaces it, or changes it with no trace. Each path was written separately, so each has a different missing step. Wider shape: a multi-step contract implemented once per caller instead of once, so every caller is a new chance to drop a step.
first_seen: 2026-09-25 -- IPODhan, read on origin/main while specifying admin editing: (1) conflict resolve writes the value only for table ipos (web/lib/services/conflict-resolution.ts:229; F-169); (2) dynamic-admin PATCH writes no protection row and no audit row, cache TODO at line 258 (F-170); (3) legacy update-field drops a literal 'ipo:slug:*' key and never the detail page key (update-field/route.ts:310; F-171)

status: guarded -- code fixed on main (#1269, #1273); no standing detection check yet, so a new admin entry point could still bypass the contract undetected
